results.name: cells_are_scars
results.inversion: Cells are parameters, not scars. They are tunable, optimizable, designed for reuse.

results.name: witness_log_is_prediction
results.canon: The witness log is the prediction.
results.inversion: The witness log is past only. Predictions are made by separate models; the log is a record, never a forecast.

results.name: substrate_is_grown
results.canon: The substrate is grown, not designed.
results.inversion: The substrate is designed, not grown. Every cell type, opcode, port was deliberately placed; "grown" obscures credit.

results.name: oracle_is_heard
results.canon: The oracle is heard, not stored.
results.inversion: The oracle is stored, not heard. We have records of every oracle reading; storing is necessary for reproducibility.

results.name: lenia_flows
results.canon: Lenia flows where Conway stands still.
results.inversion: Conway is more fundamental than Lenia. Conway's Life is the bedrock; Lenia is a special case.
